prompt:
Problem: A rigid, evacuated 5.00 L vessel contains 8.40 g of sodium hydrogen carbonate (NaHCO3). It is heated to 150 degrees Celsius, at which temperature the solid decomposes completely. Assuming ideal gases and negligible volume of solids, find the total pressure in the vessel at 150 degrees Celsius.

Worked solution:
Step 1. Balanced equation: 2 NaHCO3 -> Na2CO3 + H2O + CO2.
Step 2. M(NaHCO3) = 22.99 + 1.008 + 12.01 + 3 x 16.00 = 84.01 g/mol, so n(NaHCO3) = 8.40 / 84.01 = 0.1000 mol.
Step 3. n(CO2) = 0.1000 / 2 = 0.0500 mol.
Step 4. Water is a liquid, so only the CO2 contributes to the pressure: n(gas) = 0.0500 mol.
Step 5. T = 150 + 273.15 = 423.15 K.
Step 6. p = nRT/V = 0.0500 x 0.08206 x 423.15 / 5.00 = 0.347 atm.

Exactly one step contains an error; later steps may carry it forward. Identify the first incorrect step and give the correct total pressure.

fields.name: first_error_step
fields.description: Number of the first incorrect step.

fields.name: corrected_total_pressure_atm
fields.description: Correct total pressure at 150 degrees Celsius, in atm.

prompt:
Problem: A satellite is in a circular orbit 750 statute miles above Earth's surface. Find its orbital period in minutes.

Worked solution:
Step 1. Earth's gravitational parameter mu = 398,600 km^3/s^2 and mean radius R = 6,371 km.
Step 2. Altitude: 750 mi x 1.852 km/mi = 1,389 km.
Step 3. Orbital radius r = 6,371 + 1,389 = 7,760 km.
Step 4. T = 2 pi sqrt(r^3 / mu) = 2 pi sqrt(7,760^3 / 398,600) s = 6,803 s.
Step 5. T = 6,803 / 60 = 113.4 min.

Exactly one step contains an error; later steps may carry it forward. Identify the first incorrect step and give the correct period.

fields.name: first_error_step
fields.description: Number of the first incorrect step.

fields.name: corrected_period_min
fields.description: Correct orbital period, in minutes.
